Job Title: Drupal Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC (Union Station) 
 Duration: Dec 31st 2017 (potential to extend) 
 
 Hourly Rate: $45-50/hour 
 
 MUST BE LOCAL FACE TO FACE REQUIRED 
 
 Top Skills: Drupal 7, PHP, Custom Module Development 
 Job Description: 
 · Experience with PHP, Web Interface Design, connecting web front-ends to back-end databases and systems, and object-oriented software design practices. 
 · Drupal custom module development 
 · Experience using Web APIs 
 · Experience using client side Java Script libraries such as AngularJS, Knockout and Backbone.js, use of jQuery and AJAX , XHTML, CSS and cross browser compatibility. 
 · Ability to understand requirements, design and perform technical systems analysis and support technology users at all levels, is required. 
 · Experience with version control systems and collaborative team-based development. 
 · Strong oral and written communication skills . 
 · Knowledge of Agile software development methods and DevOps approach is desired. 
 
 Must haves: 
 · H and coding in PHP 
 · C ustom Drupal module development 
 
 NICE TO HAVES: 
 · web forms 
 · web services 
 · XML 
 · MySQL (they have database developers who will be doing most of this support when migrated) 
 
 Skill Matrix: 
 Coding in PHP

 If you are interested in above position, please share your updated resume to gmahesh(at)usmsystems(dot)com or can directly call me on 703-880-4184.
